svg.title: Measure detection delay and capability loss on separate clocks
svg.desc: Schematic with no numeric results. The detection clock runs from source event through workspace arrival and alert to the response request, t3. The access clock probes the same fixed token: a baseline before the action, the response at t3, the last allowed request, a transition interval, and the first qualified denial, or no denial before the observation limit.
